title: OrganizerProgramListCallableResponse
description: Organizer-manager or creator-scoped program inventory; exact-ID rediscovery also accepts approved program administrators. Summaries contain no guest or logistics data.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to recover the Program's civil calendar dates from its stored instants.

functionCount.description: Exact count of constituent program events for a completely read authorized batch. Omitted when unavailable or the bounded batch is incomplete; absence never means zero.

canArchive.description: This actor is the immutable creator and the program is not archived. The archive callable still checks current account and revision.

canUnarchive.description: This actor is the immutable creator and the program is archived. Grace, anonymization, active retention lease and revision checks still determine whether restoration can execute.

archivedAtMillis.description: Set when the program is archived; null otherwise.

anonymizeAtMillis.description: Grace deadline after which identity fields are scrubbed.

anonymizedAtMillis.description: Set once identity/free-text fields were scrubbed.

guestCount.description: Planner overview: guests in the programme, for a completely read batch. Omitted when unavailable; absence never means zero.

flyingInCount.description: Planner overview: inbound journeys. Omitted when unavailable.

repliedShare.description: Planner overview: the share of guests who have replied (any answer but pending). Omitted when unavailable or the programme has no guests.

billedMinor.description: Planner overview: Catch fees billed for this programme in minor units. Reserved; omitted until programme billing lines exist.

nextCursor.description: Opaque stable cursor for the last returned startsAt/program-ID tuple when another page exists, otherwise null. Optional for legacy readers.
